summary: test_client_only_selection_rejects_unsafe_bootstrap_without_mutation drives the real _select_existing_integrated_auth over a real (symlink / 0644-insecure) default credential and asserts it raises ValueError before returning; the helper constructs no client, and REQ-054.3.3's ordering test proves auth-select runs before _make_client, so an invalid credential genuinely fails before client construction. Real filesystem, no over-mocking; a regression that accepted the bad credential would fail the raises assertion.
